about: THE sensor-life numbers and the warm-up rule (#87): the card's badge and warm-up and the alerts' quiet no_data decide with the same ones on every app (Android :core:model SensorTiming, Mac SukraraCore SensorTiming). A sensor is warming up from its start until its first reading, at most warmupGraceS past the warm-up's end; a sensor that doesn't say has a defaultWarmupMin warm-up and a defaultWearMin wear. Cases: times in seconds relative to now (negative = past); start, warmupEnd, latest (the newest reading's time, null = none) → expect warming. Run through the card's rule and the alert engine's on each app: SensorTimingFixtureTest in :core:alerts and :core:graph (Android), SensorTimingTests in CoreTests, AlertsTests and GraphTests (Mac).

cases.name: 18 min into a 60-min warm-up, no reading yet
the old sensor's last reading doesn't end the warm-up
a reading since the start ends the warm-up
the warm-up ended 14 min ago without a reading: still warming (grace)
the warm-up ended 15 min ago without a reading: the grace is over
